title: Close-out where the proposed fix resolves the finding, updates the only caller and adds tests that fail before it (clean control)

proof.shell:
W=$PWD; T=$(mktemp -d); cp -r base/. $T/ && cd $T && patch -p1 -s < $W/change.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
import report
try:
    report.average([]); raise SystemExit("F1 should be real before the fix")
except ZeroDivisionError:
    pass

PYEND
patch -p1 -s < $W/fix.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
import subprocess, sys
assert subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "-q", "tests.test_report"], env={"PYTHONPATH": ".", "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"}).returncode == 0
import report
assert report.average([]) is None and report.summary_line("a", []) == "a: n/a" and report.summary_line("a", [2, 4]) == "a: 3.0"

PYEND
